categories.name: Getting Started
commands: This menu. Click a category to see its commands.
Open the quest book (or press L). Every quest pays CobbleDollars.
Open your jobs: progress, next step and rewards.
Find one in any village to start a trainer series and raise your Level Cap.
See the top trainers and your own rank.
Equip trails and give your Pokémon auras.
Browse every cosmetic and how to get it.
Let everyone know you're away. Move or chat to come back.
Put the server's keybind layout back.

categories.name: Getting Around
commands: Open the warp menu: spawn, EV training, crates, shop and more.
Teleport somewhere random in the wild.
Return to where you were before your last teleport.
Ask to teleport to a friend.
Ask a friend to teleport to you.
Go to one of your homes. Set one with /sethome [name]; see them all with /homes (3 free, buy up to 30).
Player-built safe zones, in /warp. Ask an admin or mod to add yours.

categories.name: Trading
commands: Buy, sell and auction Pokémon and items.
Collect sales, refunds and won auctions.
Swap a Pokémon for a random one, anonymously.

categories.name: Money and Shop
commands: Poké Balls, healing, training, Mega Stones, held items, keys, titles and more.
Open the sell box: drop items in and sell them all at once.
Quickly sell the stack in your hand.
Sell every one of the held item you carry.
See what the item in your hand is worth.

categories.name: Crates and Keys
commands: See every reward, its chance and your pity.
Preview a crate from anywhere: poke, great, ultra or master.
Merge keys into a higher tier, for a fee.

categories.name: Titles and Colors
commands: Pick a title to show in chat and the tab list.
Pick a color for your name.

categories.name: Pokémon
commands: Challenge another trainer to a battle: pick the level, Singles or Doubles, and an optional wager.
See which of your Pokémon have Pokérus.
You get a ping when something rare spawns near you.
Daily, weekly and monthly goals in the quest book. Finishing all of one tier pays crate keys.
Wild Pokémon your team knocks out still count toward chores.

commands: Travel to the Battle Frontier (once you've earned your Ticket to the Frontier).
Set up a run (in the Frontier lobby).
Reopen the door choice or room menu.
Leave your run and bank your rewards (/frontier quit works too).

Titles, Symbols and how to earn them.
